newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to price $350 mln FRN's Monday.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to price $350 mln FRN's Monday.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday it will price $350 million of short-term floating rate notes on Monday, June 9.
When-issued trading is expected to begin at 0820 hrs EDT (1220 GMT) the following day, it said.
The notes are for settlement June 12. Maturity date is Dec 18, 1997. Cusip number is 86387TFK9.
Sallie Mae said the notes will be priced at a spread to the bond equivalent rate of the 91-day Treasury bill, with the interest rate reset the day after each weekly T-bill auction.
